name: AddEventHandler
summary: Listens for a local event.
description: Registers a callback on the current resource's local event bus. The handler is owned by the current resource generation and is discarded automatically when that generation stops or reloads; it never receives network traffic unless the event was separately registered as a network event.

name: ClearTimeout
summary: Cancels a timer created by `SetTimeout`.
description: Cancels a pending timeout owned by the current resource generation. It returns `false` when the id is unknown or the callback has already begun; cancelling cannot interrupt a callback that is currently running.

name: CreateThread
summary: Starts a coroutine managed by the host.
description: Its body may call `Wait`, which an ordinary function cannot.
example:
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        print(CyberM.character.speed())
        Wait(1000)
    end
end)

name: DeleteResourceKvp
summary: FiveM-style alias for `CyberM.kvp.delete`.
description: FiveM-familiar alias for `CyberM.kvp.delete`. It atomically removes only the named key owned by the calling resource and reports whether that key existed.

name: GetCurrentResourceName
summary: Name of the current resource.
description: Returns the immutable manifest name of the resource whose Lua VM is executing. Use it for diagnostics and namespacing, not as a mutable display label.

name: GetInvokingResource
summary: Real caller of the currently executing export.
description: Returns nil outside an export callback. Use this value for service ownership instead of accepting a forgeable owner argument.

name: GetInvokingResourceGeneration
summary: Generation of the resource invoking the current export.
description: Returns nil outside an export callback. A changed generation lets a service retire handles left by an older VM.

name: GetResourceKvp
summary: FiveM-style alias for `CyberM.kvp.get`.
description: FiveM-familiar alias for `CyberM.kvp.get`. It returns the original stored Lua type or nil when absent and stays inside the active connection-address and calling-resource namespace.

name: GetResourceState
summary: State of a resource.
description: Reads the lifecycle state currently known by the client resource host. This is a snapshot only: it does not start, stop, or wait for the target resource.

name: RegisterNetEvent
summary: Allows an event to arrive from the server.
description: Allows an authenticated server event with this name to enter the current resource, and optionally attaches a handler in the same call. Registration is generation-scoped, requires `network.events`, and does not turn arbitrary client events into server events.

name: RemoveEventHandler
summary: Removes a handler.
description: Removes the exact callback previously registered for the named local event. It returns `false` when that event/callback pair is not owned by the current resource generation.

name: SetResourceKvp
summary: FiveM-style alias for `CyberM.kvp.set`.
description: FiveM-familiar alias for `CyberM.kvp.set`. It stores one typed value in the calling resource's persistent namespace for the active connection address; it cannot select another server or resource.

name: SetTimeout
summary: Runs a function once, later.
description: Schedules a Lua callback after at least the requested number of milliseconds without blocking the game thread. The timer belongs to the current resource generation and is cancelled automatically on stop or hot reload.

name: TriggerEvent
summary: Fires a local event.
description: Dispatches an event only inside the client resource runtime. Arguments must fit the runtime's bounded script-value representation; use `TriggerServerEvent` for traffic that must cross the network.

name: TriggerServerEvent
summary: Sends an event to the server.
description: Serializes and sends an event to the connected server with the caller's authenticated player identity. It requires `network.events`; tables must be serializable and payload limits are enforced before anything is queued.

name: Wait
summary: Suspends the current coroutine.
description: Only usable inside a `CreateThread`.

name: exports
summary: Declares a function callable by other resources.
description: Publishes a named function from the current resource so another resource can call it through `CyberM.exports.call`. The registration is tied to the current generation, so stale functions cannot survive a stop or hot reload.

name: print
summary: Writes to the CyberM log, prefixed with the resource name.
description: Writes a resource-prefixed line to the CyberM log. Values are converted with bounded formatting; this does not send a chat message or write into a WebUI page.

name: require
summary: Loads a module from the resource.
description: Loads a Lua module declared inside the current resource and caches its result for that resource generation. Resolution stays inside the sandbox: it does not expose the host filesystem, native `package` loaders, or modules from another resource.

name: await
summary: Waits for a promise to settle.
description: Only usable inside a `CreateThread`.

name: status
summary: State of the promise, without waiting.
description: Returns the promise state without yielding the current coroutine. Use it for polling or diagnostics; `await()` remains the normal way to receive a completed export result.

name: current
summary: The clip a body is currently playing.
description: Returns false when it is playing nothing — which is a state, not an error.

name: play
summary: Plays a named animation on a body.
description: Does not work on the local player: their body cannot hold a workspot. Use `CyberM.animations.playSelf` for that, which stands a double in for them.
example:
local ok, reason = CyberM.animations.play(entityId, "emote_smoke")
if not ok then print("refused: " .. reason) end

name: playSelf
summary: Plays an emote on the local player, through a stand-in body.
description: The player's own body cannot hold a workspot, so an invisible double takes their place for the length of the clip. This is a separate call rather than `play` with the player's id because the mechanism is genuinely different.

name: stop
summary: Stops whatever a body is playing and releases what was set up for it.
description: Stops the workspot animation currently managed by CyberM for the selected body and releases its native animation state. It does not claim or stop arbitrary game animations that CyberM does not own.

name: stopSelf
summary: Stops the local player's emote and removes the stand-in.
description: Ends the local-player emote created by `playSelf` and removes its stand-in body. Cleanup is idempotent and is also performed when the owning resource generation stops.

name: apply
summary: Applies a previously captured appearance snapshot to the local player.
description: Requires `player.appearance.edit`. The runtime validates the schema, build, catalog digest, gender, option identities, choice bounds, and duplicates before touching the game.

name: capture
summary: Captures the local player's complete validated appearance snapshot.
description: Requires `player.appearance.read`. The snapshot is bound to schema version 1, game build 2.31, a catalog digest, gender hash, and at most 256 head/body/arms options.
returns: table { schemaVersion, gameBuild, catalogDigest, gender, options }, or nil

name: finishCommit
summary: Finishes the current appearance commit transaction.
description: Requires `player.appearance.edit`. Call after a successful apply/persistence flow so the native editor can release its commit state.

name: isOpen
summary: Whether the local appearance editor is open.
description: Requires `player.appearance.read`; returns false when the permission or backend is unavailable.

name: open
summary: Opens the local Cyberpunk appearance editor.
description: Requires `player.appearance.edit`. The optional value may be a mode string or `{ mode = string }`; `ripperdoc` is used by default.

name: list
summary: Lists generic files declared by the current resource.
description: Returns the resource files declared by the current manifest. It is an allow-list view, not a directory listing, and does not grant access to undeclared files or arbitrary paths.

name: texture
summary: Validates a declared PNG texture for resource APIs.
description: The path must match the manifest's `files` allowlist. PNG textures are limited to 512 KiB and 512 by 512 pixels.
returns: descriptor { type, asset, mime, width, height, bytes }, or nil

name: attachToEntity
summary: Makes a blip follow a CyberM entity.
description: Changes an owned blip from a fixed world position to tracking a streamed CyberM entity. The entity id is ephemeral and the call requires `ui.vanilla.map`; remove or reattach the blip when its gameplay target changes.

name: clear
summary: Removes every blip owned by the current resource.
description: Removes every vanilla-map blip owned by the calling resource generation. Other resources' blips are left untouched, and generation teardown performs the same cleanup automatically.

name: create
summary: Creates a resource-owned vanilla map pin.
description: Requires `ui.vanilla.map`. Provide exactly one of `position` or `entity`. The returned 64-bit generation handle is a decimal string and is cleaned up automatically when the resource stops.

params.name: options
params.type: table { position|entity, sprite?, label?, icon?, active?, visibleThroughWalls?, slot?, offset? }

name: get
summary: Reads one blip owned by the current resource.
description: Returns a read-only snapshot of one blip owned by the calling resource. The handle must still belong to the current generation; a stale or foreign id is rejected.

name: list
summary: Lists blips owned by the current resource.
description: Lists snapshots of all vanilla-map blips owned by the calling resource generation. The returned tables are copies and changing them does not mutate the map.

name: remove
summary: Removes one owned blip.
description: Deletes one blip owned by the calling resource and invalidates its handle. Removal is resource-scoped, so one package cannot erase another package's map state.

name: setActive
summary: Activates or deactivates a vanilla mappin.
description: Updates the active/highlighted state of an owned vanilla-map blip. This changes presentation only and does not create a route or change server state.

name: setDescription
summary: Sets the custom fullscreen-map description of an owned blip.
description: Requires `ui.vanilla.map`. The description is displayed by CyberM's fullscreen-map tooltip for the selected native mappin.

name: setIcon
summary: Sets a declared PNG icon or restores the native sprite.
description: Accepts a path, a texture descriptor, `{ asset, size }`, or false. The native mappin remains underneath for map selection, routing, tooltips, and fallback.

name: setLabel
summary: Changes the fullscreen-map tooltip title.
description: CyberM keeps the label in private script data, independent from the vanilla variant's generic title.

name: setPosition
summary: Moves a blip to a world position.
description: Also detaches an entity-following blip.

name: setSprite
summary: Changes the vanilla mappin variant.
description: Accepts an exact 2.31 variant name, a stable alias, or an integer from 0 through 146. See `wiki/blips.md` for the complete list.

name: setTitle
summary: Sets the custom fullscreen-map title of an owned blip.
description: Requires `ui.vanilla.map`. This is the semantic title alias of `setLabel`; the HUD does not permanently render it beside the icon.

name: setTrackingAlternative
summary: Sets another owned blip as the routing alternative.
description: Passing nil clears it. This does not force the world-map controller to start tracking.

name: setVisibleThroughWalls
summary: Changes vanilla through-wall visibility.
description: Controls whether an owned world marker remains visible when geometry occludes it. The setting affects presentation on this client only and requires `ui.vanilla.map`.

name: sprites
summary: Lists every usable mappin variant in the current build.
description: Returns 147 entries for Cyberpunk 2077 2.31. This metadata query does not require map mutation permission.

name: untrack
summary: Safely clears manual tracking for this blip.
description: The native action is invoked only if this owned blip is currently tracked, so a resource cannot untrack a quest or another system's pin.

name: update
summary: Updates several properties of an owned blip.
description: A replacement mappin is registered before the previous one is removed. `position` switches to positional mode; `entity` switches to attached mode.

name: attach
summary: Reattaches the camera to the body.
description: Attaches the CyberM camera to a game entity using the supplied local offset and rotation. Camera ownership is local to the resource generation; attaching replaces the resource's previous detached/attached camera state.

name: detach
summary: Detaches the camera from the body, with an offset in the body's own space.
description: Detaches the CyberM camera from its target while retaining a controllable camera view. It does not synchronize a camera to other players and is automatically restored during resource cleanup.

name: project
summary: Projects a world point into normalized WebUI viewport coordinates.
description: Uses REDengine's active camera projection. `(0,0)` is the top-left and `(1,1)` the bottom-right. `onScreen` is false for points behind the view or beyond the viewport.
returns: table { x, y, depth, distance, onScreen }, or nil

name: setFov
summary: Sets the field of view, in degrees.
description: Changes the field of view of the camera currently controlled by CyberM. The value is validated by the native backend and applies only to this client's presentation.

name: thirdPerson
summary: Switches the view to third person.
description: Turning it off restores the view the game had before the call, rather than some default.

name: view
summary: Where the view is: position, forward vector, field of view.
description: Returns the latest game-thread camera snapshot used by projection and presentation APIs. It is a same-client read and may return `nil, reason` while the game camera is unavailable.

name: animation
summary: The animation currently playing on this character.
description: Reads the current animation snapshot for an entity, or for the local player when omitted. The result is observational and can change on the next frame; it does not grant animation ownership.

name: groundSpeed
summary: Speed projected on the ground, without the vertical component.
description: Returns horizontal movement speed for the selected character, excluding vertical velocity. Entity ids refer to the current client stream and must not be persisted as server identity.

name: health
summary: Current health.
description: Reads the engine-side health visible for the selected character on this client. For replicated player gameplay rules use the server-authoritative player health APIs; this helper is a presentation snapshot, not authority.

name: isAlive
summary: Whether the character is alive.
description: Reports the current engine alive/dead flag for the selected character. It is useful for presentation and diagnostics but may lag the authoritative server health transition by a replication frame.

name: isArmed
summary: Whether a weapon is drawn.
description: Reports whether the selected character is currently considered armed by the game presentation state. It does not enumerate inventory or prove that a weapon action is server-authorized.

name: isCrouched
summary: Whether the character is crouching.
description: Reads the character's current crouch presentation flag. Omit the entity to inspect the local player; remote values exist only while that proxy is streamed.

name: isDriver
summary: Whether they occupy the driver's seat.
description: Returns whether the selected character occupies the canonical driver seat of a vehicle. Use `seat()` when the exact seat and vehicle entity are also needed.

name: isEmoting
summary: Whether they hold a workspot (an emote is running).
description: Reports whether CyberM currently presents the character in an emote/workspot state. This is a transient local snapshot and is cleared with the owning presentation lifecycle.

name: isGrounded
summary: Whether the character is touching the ground.
description: Reads the engine grounded flag for the selected character. The value is sampled from the current client frame and should not be used alone for authoritative movement validation.

name: isInVehicle
summary: Whether the character is mounted in a vehicle.
description: Reports whether the character is mounted in a vehicle according to the current client presentation. Call `seat()` to retrieve the mounted slot and vehicle entity id.

name: isSliding
summary: Whether the character is sliding.
description: Reads the current sliding locomotion flag for the selected character. It is an observational state and does not start or stop a slide.

name: isVaulting
summary: Whether the character is vaulting.
description: Reads the current vaulting locomotion flag for the selected character. Remote values are available only while the corresponding proxy is streamed.

name: position
summary: The character's position.
description: Returns the character's current world-space coordinates from the game-thread snapshot. Omit the entity for the local player; do not persist a client entity id as a network identity.

name: seat
summary: The seat occupied in a vehicle, if any.
description: Returns the canonical seat name and the mounted vehicle's client entity id when the character is in a vehicle. A character that is not mounted returns `nil`; both values are snapshots and the entity id is valid only in the current client stream.
returns: seat name and vehicle entity id, or nil
reason when the character could not be read

name: speed
summary: Instantaneous speed, all components.
description: Returns total character movement speed, including vertical motion, from the latest local snapshot. Use `groundSpeed()` when only horizontal locomotion is relevant.

name: state
summary: One complete snapshot of a character.
description:
A single engine pass fills the whole record even when the caller only wanted the speed. That is deliberate: every field then describes the **same instant**, so a caller cannot see a body grounded and airborne in the same breath.

With no argument, answers about the local player.
returns: table { isPlayer, attached, id, engineId, position, orientation, forward, velocity, speed, groundSpeed, yaw, alive, health, grounded, crouched, sliding, vaulting, air, fall, landing, weapon…, inVehicle, seat, driver }
reason, when the first is nil
example:
local s = CyberM.character.state()
if s.inVehicle and s.driver then
    print("driving at " .. math.floor(s.speed) .. " u/s")
end

name: weapon
summary: The equipped weapon and its state.
description: Returns the drawn weapon's recognized item id and category for the selected character. It returns `nil` when no recognized weapon is currently presented and does not expose or mutate inventory.
returns: reason when the character could not be read

name: yaw
summary: Horizontal orientation, in degrees.
description: Returns the selected character's current world yaw in degrees. The value is a presentation snapshot and should be normalized by the caller when computing angular deltas.

name: setText
summary: Writes UTF-8 text to the operating-system clipboard.
description: Client-only and requires `clipboard.write` on the resource whose VM performs the call. Text is limited to 256 KiB, must be valid UTF-8 and cannot contain an embedded NUL. The operation is write-only: resources cannot inspect the user's existing clipboard. A temporarily owned clipboard returns `false, clipboard_busy`; callers should let the player retry instead of polling every frame.
example: local ok, reason = CyberM.clipboard.setText("position = { x = 1, y = 2, z = 3 }")

name: command
summary: Runs one registered native laboratory command directly.
description: Requires `debug.runtime` and the trusted `cyberm_debug` owner. Input is limited to 4096 bytes and unknown commands are not forwarded to the server.
returns: true and command result on success

name: eval
summary: Compiles and executes a bounded text-only Lua chunk in the privileged debug VM.
description: Requires `debug.runtime` and the trusted `cyberm_debug` owner. Source is limited to 32 KiB, the optional chunk label to 64 bytes, returned values to 16 and result text to 8 KiB. The ordinary memory, instruction and frame-time quotas remain active.
returns: true and bounded result text on success

name: redscript
summary: Queues one bounded command through the REDscript debug bridge.
description: Requires `debug.runtime` and the trusted `cyberm_debug` owner. The opaque command is limited to 4096 bytes and executes from a genuine REDscript frame.
returns: true and bridge result on success

name: aimed
summary: The streamed door currently under the crosshair.
description: Requires `world.doors`. The returned `id` is an opaque 64-bit REDengine identity encoded as a string; never convert it to a Lua number. A successful discovery also makes that door addressable by `state` and the command functions while it remains streamed.
returns: reason when the first is nil
example:
local door, reason = CyberM.doors.aimed()
if door then
    print(door.id, door.open, door.locked, door.distance)
end

name: available
summary: Whether the client door backend is available.
description: This capability check does not discover or stream a door. Door operations require the `world.doors` permission.

name: clearInteractionPolicy
summary: Removes this resource's interaction policy for a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Other resources' policies are unaffected.

name: close
summary: Closes a door.
description: Alias of `setOpen(door, false, force)`. Requires `world.doors`; application is asynchronous.

name: closest
summary: The closest streamed door around the local player.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Uses the same 0.5 to 100 metre player-centered query as `near`.
returns: reason when the first is nil

name: grantKey
summary: Grants an entity an opening token for a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Uses the door controller's native token mechanism rather than a parallel CyberM key list. This grants authorization but does not lock or deny an otherwise usable door; access enforcement belongs to `setInteractionAllowed`.

name: hasKey
summary: Whether an entity holds an opening token for a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`.
returns: reason when the first is nil

name: holders
summary: The entities holding an opening token for a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Holder IDs are opaque strings for the same precision reason as door IDs. Tokens are vanilla authorization data, not a global lock rule: an unlocked interactive door remains usable with no token. Combine `hasKey` with `setInteractionAllowed` when implementing an ox_doorlock-style policy.
returns: array of opaque entity ids, or nil
reason when the first is nil

name: lock
summary: Locks a door.
description: Alias of `setLocked(door, true, force)`.

name: near
summary: All streamed doors around the local player.
description: Requires `world.doors`. The radius is centered on the player and must be between 0.5 and 100 metres. Results are sorted nearest first and register each door for later ID-based operations.
returns: array of door snapshots, or nil
reason when the first is nil

name: open
summary: Opens a door.
description: Alias of `setOpen(door, true, force)`. Requires `world.doors`; application is asynchronous.

name: reset
summary: Resets a door to its configured default state.
description: Requires `world.doors`; queues the vanilla `ResetDoorState` event.

name: revokeKey
summary: Revokes an entity's opening token for a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`.

name: seal
summary: Seals a door.
description: Alias of `setSealed(door, true, force)`.

name: setAutomaticClose
summary: Enables or disables a door's automatic closing behavior.
description: Requires `world.doors`; queues the vanilla `SetCloseItself` event.

name: setInteractionAllowed
summary: Pre-declares whether vanilla interaction may open a door.
description: Requires `world.doors`. The decision is synchronous when the game interacts with the door. Policies are owned by the resource, all active policies must allow, and they are removed automatically on stop/reload. `cyberm:doorInteract` is an observational event with `(doorId, activatorId, "true"|"false")`; it is too late to change that interaction.
example:
CyberM.doors.setInteractionAllowed(doorId, playerHasAccess)
AddEventHandler("cyberm:doorInteract", function(door, activator, allowed)
    print(door, activator, allowed)
end)

name: setLocked
summary: Sets whether a door is locked.
description: Requires `world.doors`. `force` uses the vanilla quest-authority action; application is asynchronous.

name: setOpen
summary: Sets whether a door is open.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Success means the REDscript action was accepted; application is asynchronous and may take up to 200 ms. `force` uses the vanilla quest-authority action.

name: setSealed
summary: Sets whether a door is sealed.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Sealing is distinct from locking. `force` uses the vanilla quest-authority action.

name: setState
summary: Sets a door state by name.
description: Accepted states: `open`, `closed`, `locked`, `unlocked`, `sealed`, `unsealed`. Requires `world.doors`; `force` selects the quest-authority action.

name: state
summary: A live snapshot of a streamed door.
description: Requires `world.doors`. Reads the live `DoorControllerPS`, never a fabricated default from the save record. Returns `door_not_streamed` after the entity unloads. Snapshot fields include `id`, `class`, `name`, `position`, `distance`, `open`, `closed`, `locked`, `sealed`, `busy`, `playerAuthorised`, `automaticClose`, toggle capabilities, shutter/lift flags, type/sides and opening speed/time.
returns: reason when the first is nil

name: unlock
summary: Unlocks a door.
description: Alias of `setLocked(door, false, force)`.

name: unseal
summary: Unseals a door.
description: Alias of `setSealed(door, false, force)`.

name: all
summary: Lists every replicated elevator state visible to the client.
description: Requires `elevators.read`; returns an empty array when the capability or backend is unavailable.

name: get
summary: Reads one replicated elevator by CyberM ID.
description: Requires `elevators.read`. Elevator IDs are server-assigned and should be kept unchanged.
returns: table { id, revision, bucket, engineEntity, activeFloor, originFloor, targetFloor, floorCount, travelMs, remainingMs, flags, phase, position, streamed, applied }, or nil

name: nearby
summary: Discovers streamed native elevators around the local player.
description: Requires `elevators.read`. Radius must be between 1 and 300 metres. Results distinguish unmanaged engine lifts from elevators already adopted by CyberM.
returns: array of { engineEntity, controllerEntity, position, distance, managed, floorCount, activeFloor, id }

name: request
summary: Submits a floor request to the authoritative server.
description: Requires `elevators.request`. `action` is normally `call` or `goto`; the server validates the ID, floor, player bucket, range, state and policy.

name: getTime
summary: Lit l'horloge REDengine locale.
description: Primitive interne protégée par `world.environment`. Retourne un snapshot atomique de l'heure appliquée et de l'état de pause. Dans une session normale, utilisez l'export `cyberm_weather.getState` plutôt que cette valeur de projection.
returns: table { day, hour, minute, second, totalSeconds, frozen }, ou nil

name: isWeatherFrozen
summary: Indique si la météo automatique vanilla est neutralisée.
description: Demande `world.environment`.

name: setTime
summary: Projette une heure serveur dans REDengine.
description: Demande `world.environment`. `cyberm_weather` est normalement le seul propriétaire de cette permission. REDengine choisit la prochaine occurrence de l'heure demandée ; le package officiel filtre donc les petits reculs réseau pour éviter un saut d'un jour.
returns: true en cas de succès, sinon false

name: setTimeFrozen
summary: Fige ou libère uniquement l'horloge du jeu.
description: Ne fige pas la simulation. Demande `world.environment`; utilisé par la projection serveur pour neutraliser la vitesse vanilla.
returns: true en cas de succès, sinon false

name: setWeather
summary: Applique un preset météo REDengine.
description: Primitive interne demandant `world.environment`. Le second retour `applied=false` est aussi possible en cas de succès si le preset était déjà actif.
returns: true en cas de succès, sinon false
applied si succès, sinon raison du refus

name: setWeatherFrozen
summary: Désactive ou réactive le contrôleur météo automatique vanilla.
description: Demande `world.environment`. Figer conserve le preset courant et laisse le serveur décider du prochain événement.
returns: true en cas de succès, sinon false

name: emit
summary: Fires a local event.
description: Emits an event on the resource-local client bus and invokes matching local handlers. It never sends a packet; use the network event API for server communication.

name: off
summary: Removes a handler registered with `on`.
description: Unregisters a local event handler id previously returned by `on`/`AddEventHandler`. Handler ids are owned by a resource generation and cannot remove another resource's callback.

name: on
summary: Listens for a local event.
description: Same as the `AddEventHandler` global. Events emitted by the plugin — `cyberm:pauseKey`, `cyberm:inspector:on` — arrive here.

name: call
summary: Calls a function exported by another resource.
description: Schedules another running client resource's exported function and returns a generation-bound Promise. Arguments and results must be serializable; unavailable resources, missing exports, stale generations and scheduler saturation are returned immediately as `nil, reason`.

name: isCaptured
summary: Whether another WebUI currently owns keyboard input.
description: Contextual actions should become inert while this is true so chat and menu typing cannot activate gameplay.

name: isDown
summary: Whether an allowlisted contextual action key is currently held.
description: Requires `input.actions`. Supported keys are A-Z, 0-9, SPACE, ENTER/RETURN, and arrows. Prefer a press edge or hold timer over firing every frame.
returns: reason when the key or permission is refused

name: enable
summary: Turns the permanent aim ray on or off.
description: Turning it off also clears the outline: the outline belongs to the session that asked for it and must not outlive it.
returns: reason, when the first is nil

name: outline
summary: Outlines the aimed object, independently of the ray.
description: Lets a caller read the target without painting the world. The outline uses `entRenderHighlightEvent`, the same event focus mode and scanning already use.
returns: reason, when the first is nil

name: target
summary: What the aim ray is currently pointing at.
description:
Reads a snapshot, never a probe. The ray has to be cast on the game thread, and the plugin refreshes it at 10 Hz, so calling this costs nothing and cannot land a raycast on the wrong thread.

Always returns a table when a game is present. `valid` separates "nothing in view" from "no game" — the latter returns `nil, reason`.
returns: table { valid, engineId, class, name, kind, position, distance }
reason, when the first is nil
example:
local t = CyberM.inspector.target()
if t and t.valid then
    print(t.kind, t.name, t.distance)   --> door  Door  1.38
end

name: decode
summary: Parses a JSON string.
description: Parses JSON into CyberM's bounded Lua value model. Invalid JSON returns `nil, "invalid_json"`; decoded objects and arrays contain only supported scalar/table values.

name: encode
summary: Serialises a Lua value to JSON.
description: Serializes a supported Lua value to JSON using the same bounded representation used by events, exports and WebUI. Functions, userdata, cycles and unsupported table shapes return `nil, reason`.

name: clear
summary: Clears this resource's keys matching a prefix.
description: Atomically removes every key matching an optional prefix from the calling resource's current-server store and returns the removal count. An empty prefix clears only that resource namespace.

name: compareAndSet
summary: Atomically changes a key when its typed value matches.
description: Atomically replaces a key only when its typed value exactly matches the expected value. Nil expected means the key must be absent; nil replacement deletes after a successful comparison.

name: delete
summary: Deletes one persistent key.
description: Atomically deletes one key from the current resource store and returns whether it existed. Deleting a missing key succeeds with false.
returns: true when removed, false when absent

name: find
summary: Finds typed entries by sorted key prefix.
description: Performs a sorted prefix search in the current resource store and returns bounded `{key, value, type}` records. The default result limit is 256 and the hard limit is 4096.
returns: array of { key, value, type }, or nil

name: get
summary: Reads one typed persistent value.
description: Reads a typed value from the current connection-address and resource namespace. Missing keys return the optional default (or nil) and are distinct from storage errors, which return `nil, reason`.

name: has
summary: Checks whether a persistent key exists.
description: Checks whether a key exists in the calling resource's current-server store without exposing its value or any other resource namespace.

name: increment
summary: Atomically increments a numeric key.
description: Atomically creates or increments a numeric key. Integer arithmetic remains 64-bit and rejects overflow; mixed/floating arithmetic rejects non-finite results.

name: keys
summary: Lists sorted keys matching a prefix.
description: Returns only the sorted keys matching an optional prefix in the current resource store. It is a bounded index query and cannot enumerate another package or connection address.

name: set
summary: Persists one typed value for this server address and resource.
description: Atomically persists a string, signed integer, finite number or boolean under the current connection address and resource. Keys/values and the 1 MiB resource quota are validated before the old file is replaced.

name: setIfAbsent
summary: Stores a value only when its key is missing.
description: Redis-style SETNX for the current resource namespace: atomically stores the typed value only when the key is missing and reports whether insertion occurred.

name: stats
summary: Returns this resource store's usage and quotas.
description: Returns this resource's entry/byte usage and enforced quotas together with the active address/resource scope. It exposes no keys or usage belonging to other resources.

name: acceptPickup
summary: Applique localement un pickup déjà accepté par le serveur.
description: API interne appelée uniquement après `cyberm:loot:pickupResult`. Elle projette l'objet dans l'inventaire REDengine local; l'inventaire persistant reste une responsabilité serveur.

name: clear
summary: Supprime toutes les projections locales et leurs prompts.
description: Clears the client-side native loot projection when the caller has `world.loot`. This is intended for the authoritative loot replication package during snapshot replacement; ordinary gameplay resources should request server-owned changes instead.

name: remove
summary: Retire une projection locale de loot.
description: Removes one replicated native loot entity from this client's projection and requires `world.loot`. It does not by itself delete the server record, so gameplay code should normally use the authoritative loot package API.

name: requestPickup
summary: Demande au serveur de ramasser un drop.
description: Le serveur contrôle l'existence, le routing bucket et la distance calculée depuis son dernier snapshot du joueur.
returns: true si la requête réseau est partie

name: setAuthorityEnabled
summary: Active ou désactive la projection de loot autoritaire.
description: Réservé à `cyberm_loot`. Quand il est actif, les choix, conteneurs et drops vanilla sont neutralisés et les objets physiques deviennent de simples représentations du registre serveur.

name: upsert
summary: Crée ou met à jour la projection locale d'un drop serveur.
description: API interne de réplication. Demande la permission `world.loot`; un script gameplay ne doit pas inventer un drop côté client.

params.name: drop
params.type: table { id, item, quantity, position, radius, label, model, revision }

name: clear
summary: Removes every 3D marker owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.markers`; other resources are unaffected.

name: create
summary: Creates a resource-owned 3D world marker.
description: Requires `world.markers`. Options require `position` and accept `shape`, `style`, `radius`, `maxDistance`, `minDistance`, and `visible`. The returned decimal-string handle preserves its full 64-bit identity.

name: list
summary: Lists the calling resource's 3D markers.
description: Requires `world.markers`. Each snapshot includes its requested definition and whether the native renderer currently presents it.
returns: array of { id, shape, style, radius, maxDistance, minDistance, visible, rendered, position }, or nil

name: remove
summary: Removes one resource-owned 3D marker.
description: Requires `world.markers`.

name: update
summary: Patches a resource-owned 3D marker.
description: Requires `world.markers`. Only supplied fields are changed, and ownership prevents mutation of another resource's marker.

name: clear
summary: Removes every nameplate override owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `ui.nameplates`; other owners are unaffected.

name: remove
summary: Removes the calling resource's nameplate override for one player.
description: Requires `ui.nameplates`.

name: set
summary: Creates or updates the calling resource's nameplate override for a remote player.
description: Requires `ui.nameplates`. Options accept `label`, `color`, `maxDistance`, and `visible`. Overrides are owner-scoped and cleaned up with the resource.

name: snapshot
summary: Returns the currently rendered remote-player nameplates.
description: Requires `ui.nameplates`. Screen coordinates and distance describe the most recent presentation snapshot.
returns: array of { id, label, color, x, y, distance }, or nil

name: emitServer
summary: Sends an event to the server.
description: Alias of `TriggerServerEvent`: sends a bounded, serializable event payload to the authenticated server session. The current resource must declare `network.events`.

name: on
summary: Listens for an event coming from the server.
description: Registers an authenticated incoming server event and its callback for the current resource generation. It is the namespaced equivalent of `RegisterNetEvent` and requires `network.events`.

name: catalog
summary: The catalog as of the last refresh.
description: Reads a snapshot: refreshing is asynchronous, so call `refresh`, then `catalog` a beat later.

name: connect
summary: Joins a CyberM server.
description: Starts a connection to the supplied CyberM server endpoint using the current identity and resource pipeline. It requires `network.client`; success means the request was accepted, while connection progress and errors are observed through `status()`.
returns: true when the request is accepted

name: disconnect
summary: Leaves the current server.
description: Requests an orderly disconnect with an optional diagnostic reason. It returns after queuing teardown; the session phase in `status()` is the authoritative view of when cleanup has completed.

name: identity
summary: Reads the local Master-backed identity profile state.
description: Returns the durable user id, current display name, registration state, and asynchronous update phase. The private key is never exposed. This bridge exists for the trusted local server browser; server-downloaded resources should use the verified player APIs instead.
returns: table { phase, generation, userId, displayName, error, registered }, or nil

name: identityUpdate
summary: Requests a signed username update from the Master.
description: Queues the HTTP enrollment on the networking worker and returns immediately. Poll `identity()` until the matching generation becomes `ready` or `failed`. The backend is deliberately available only to the trusted system server-browser resource and refuses updates during a live session.

name: refresh
summary: Asks the directory for the server catalog again.
description: Starts a master-server catalog refresh for the supplied URL and requires `network.client`. The call only accepts the request; use `catalog()` to inspect generation, phase, HTTP status, body and error.

name: status
summary: State of the network session.
description: Returns the current client session snapshot: phase, endpoint, authenticated player identity, routing bucket, rates, server time, ping and downloaded resource-set metadata. Reading it does not initiate a connection or wait for a phase change.
returns: table { phase, endpoint, playerId, routingBucket, ping, error }

name: all
summary: Lists server-owned NPCs currently known by this client.
description: Canonical creation, tasks, health and removal are server-only; see wiki/npcs.md.

name: currentTask
summary: Returns the canonical active task ID for an NPC.
description: Returns the last CyberM NPC task snapshot currently presented for a network NPC. It requires `npcs.read`; task state is ephemeral and can disappear when the NPC leaves the streaming set.

name: entity
summary: Returns the ephemeral local CyberM entity handle for an NPC projection.
description: Returns nil before readiness and after stream-out. Never cache this handle across lifecycle changes.

name: get
summary: Reads one server-owned NPC currently known by this client.
description: Read-only and guarded by npcs.read. The local entity handle is generation-checked and becomes invalid after stream-out.

name: isStreamedIn
summary: Whether an NPC projection is attached and ready locally.
description: Reports whether a network NPC currently has a live client proxy in this player's streaming scope. It does not request streaming or prove that the server NPC record no longer exists.

name: allHealthStates
summary: Lists all replicated player health snapshots known to the client.
description: Requires `players.life.read`; returns an empty array when unavailable.

name: allLifeStates
summary: Lists all replicated canonical player life states known to the client.
description: Requires `players.life.read`; returns an empty array when unavailable.

name: getHealthState
summary: Reads one replicated player health snapshot.
description: Requires `players.life.read`. Omit `playerId` for the local player.
returns: table { playerId, revision, health, maxHealth, armor, godMode, lastAttacker, lastDamage, lastAttackKind, lastBodyPart, lastHitDirection }, or nil

name: getLifeState
summary: Reads the canonical replicated life state of one player.
description: Requires `players.life.read`. Omit `playerId` for the local session player.

name: getLocalDeathContext
summary: Reads the local player's replicated death context.
description: Requires `players.life.read`. The snapshot includes phase, cause, killer, weapon, position, yaw, impulse, revision and grace duration.

name: isDead
summary: Whether a player is canonically dead or awaiting revive/respawn.
description: Requires `players.life.read`. Omit `playerId` for the local player. Unknown or unavailable states return false.

name: generation
summary: Generation number, incremented on every reload.
description: With no argument, returns the current resource generation. Pass a resource name to inspect that resource, or receive nil when it is missing.

name: hasPermission
summary: Whether the resource holds this permission.
description: Checks whether the current resource manifest grants an exact CyberM capability. It is a read-only convenience check; native APIs still enforce their own permission and must handle refusal results.

name: name
summary: Name of the current resource.
description: Returns the current resource's immutable manifest name. This is equivalent to `GetCurrentResourceName()` and remains stable for the lifetime of the resource definition.

name: readFile
summary: Reads a file from the resource, within its declared allowlist.
description: Reads a file declared by the current resource manifest through a safe relative path. Undeclared files, traversal, oversized content and host filesystem paths are rejected.

name: state
summary: State of a resource.
description: Returns the lifecycle state known for a resource name, or for the current resource when omitted. It is an immediate snapshot and does not wait for dependencies or mutate lifecycle state.

name: version
summary: Version declared in `cyberm.lua`.
description: Returns the version string declared by the current resource manifest. It is package metadata and is unrelated to the CyberM runtime or Lua interpreter version.

name: luaVersion
summary: Embedded Lua version.
description: Returns the embedded Lua interpreter version used by this resource VM. Use it for diagnostics or compatibility checks, not to infer the CyberM build version.

name: version
summary: CyberM version.
description: Returns the CyberM scripting runtime version exposed to resources. This describes the host API and is distinct from both the resource manifest version and game build.

name: loadPristine
summary: Loads the local development world from CyberM's bundled pristine save.
description: No network session is armed by this operation.

name: openSettings
summary: Opens the game's own settings screen without exposing the pause menu.
description: Requests the client-side CyberM settings interface. It only changes local presentation and does not modify server configuration or another player's settings.

name: setMenuReady
summary: Declares that this resource is able to serve the pause menu.
description: The escape key is only intercepted while this is true. A resource that fails to start therefore leaves the game's own menu reachable, rather than stranding the player with none.

name: request
summary: Asks the script bridge to list the variables of a group.
description: Asynchronous: request, then read with `values` a beat later.

name: set
summary: Writes a settings variable.
description: Submits one local CyberM setting change through the settings backend. The key, value type and published bounds are validated; use `values()` to read the resulting projection.

name: values
summary: The variables as the script last reported them.
description: Returns a snapshot of the settings currently published by the client backend. The returned table is a copy and modifying it does not apply changes.
returns: table of { name, value, minimum, maximum, step }

name: clear
summary: Stops every SFX owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`; VFX and other resource owners are unaffected.

name: list
summary: Lists active SFX owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`.
returns: array of { id, kind, name, entity, remaining }, or nil

name: play
summary: Starts resource-owned spatial audio on an entity.
description: Requires `world.effects`. Options accept `entity`, `emitter`, `tag`, `seekTime`, `duration`, and `unique`; omitting `entity` uses the local player.

name: stop
summary: Stops one SFX handle owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`. REDengine stops audio by event name, so identical simultaneous events on one entity may share stop behavior.

name: monotonic
summary: Monotonic clock, in milliseconds.
description: Never goes backwards, unlike wall-clock time: this is the one to measure a duration with.

name: isNoclip
summary: Whether local-player noclip is currently active.
description: Returns false without `player.travel` or when the backend is unavailable.

name: setNoclip
summary: Enables or disables native noclip for the local player.
description: Requires `player.travel`. Multiplayer deployments should expose this only behind an ACL-checked server command.

name: setNoclipSpeed
summary: Sets the local noclip movement speed.
description: Requires `player.travel`; the value must be finite and is validated by the native backend.

name: teleport
summary: Teleports the local player directly to a world transform.
description: Requires `player.travel`. Prefer the authoritative server respawn transaction for long-distance multiplayer moves because it handles streaming and life state.

name: all
summary: Lists every vehicle currently streamed to this client.
description: Requires `vehicles.read`. Returns an empty array when permission or the projection backend is unavailable. Every entry has the exact shape returned by `CyberM.vehicles.get`; server vehicles outside the client's streaming interest set are intentionally absent.

name: get
summary: Reads one streamed server-owned vehicle.
description: Client read-only API requiring `vehicles.read`. The snapshot contains durable state (`health`, flags, six door bits, four open-window bits, tyre/glass/light masks and the 30-cell body grid), authority and occupants, an ephemeral generation-checked local entity handle, plus the latest drivetrain and wheel telemetry. Open windows and broken glass are separate states. Creation, repair and arbitrary mutation are server-only; the complete 43-method server surface is documented in `wiki/vehicles.md`.
returns: table { id, record, entity, engineEntity, revision, physicsOwner, authorityEpoch, flags, health, doors, windows, tires, bodyDamage, brokenGlass, brokenLights, damage, speed, rpm, rpmMax, throttle, brake, steering, wheelRotation, suspensionLongitudinal, suspensionTransversal, burnout, gear, onGround, reversing, streamed, locallyOwned, occupants }, or nil

name: isDoorOpen
summary: Reads a canonical vehicle door, trunk, or hood state.
description: Client read-only API requiring `vehicles.read`. Accepts index 0..5, a standard camelCase/snake_case name, or a `CyberM.vehicles.doors` constant. This reads the replicated reversible opening mask.
returns: boolean, or nil when denied, unavailable, or unknown

name: isWindowOpen
summary: Reads a canonical openable side-window state.
description: Client read-only API requiring `vehicles.read`. Windows use indexes 0..3 and names `frontLeft`, `frontRight`, `backLeft`, and `backRight`. This does not report shattered glass; inspect `brokenGlass` or `damage.glass` in the vehicle snapshot for that.
returns: boolean, or nil when denied, unavailable, or unknown

name: taskPlayerEnterVehicle
summary: Reserved animated presentation path for a replicated occupant.
description: Requires `vehicles.presentation` and an already-authorized occupancy tuple. The first native NPC `MountAIEvent` implementation could dereference an absent workspot object on remote player proxies, so this method currently fails closed with `animated_entry_unsupported`. Use `warpPlayerIntoVehicle` until the staged door/workspot implementation is validated on two clients.

name: warpPlayerIntoVehicle
summary: Presents a replicated player instantly in an authoritative vehicle seat.
description: Requires `vehicles.presentation`. This is a visual client operation for an existing server-owned vehicle and occupancy assignment; it does not claim the seat or physics authority. The exact `(player, vehicle, seat)` tuple must already exist in the replicated ledger or the call fails with `occupancy_mismatch`. Seats accept canonical names, common aliases, or FiveM-compatible -1..2 indices.

name: catalog
summary: Returns the curated stable world-VFX aliases and cooked paths.
description: Catalog access does not start an effect. Raw cooked paths remain build-dependent even when present.
returns: table mapping alias to effect path, or nil

name: clear
summary: Stops every VFX owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`; SFX and other resource owners are unaffected.

name: list
summary: Lists active VFX owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`.
returns: array of { id, kind, name, entity, remaining }, or nil

name: play
summary: Starts a resource-owned world VFX at a fixed transform.
description: Requires `world.effects`. `options` requires `position` and accepts `orientation`, `duration`, and `ignoreTimeDilation`. The effect is released automatically with its owner.

name: playEntity
summary: Starts a resource-owned authored VFX on an entity.
description: Requires `world.effects`. Options accept `entity`, `instance`, `persistOnDetach`, `breakAllLoops`, `breakAllOnDestroy`, and `duration`; omitting `entity` targets the local player.

name: stop
summary: Stops one VFX handle owned by the calling resource.
description: Requires `world.effects`.

name: create
summary: Creates a web surface.
description:
**Creation is asynchronous.** A `show()` issued right after `create` loses the race against the `visible` flag the request carried, and the surface then never paints at all. So a surface meant to stay up is created with `visible = true`, and the page shows or hides its own content.

Valid layers: `hud`, `menu`, `modal`, `system` (needs the `webui.system` permission), `debug`.

name: default
summary: The surface declared by `web_ui_page` in the manifest.
description: Returns the auto-created WebUI page declared by `web_ui_page` in the current manifest. It returns `nil, reason` when the resource has no live default page; the handle is generation-owned and becomes stale after destroy or reload.

name: destroy
summary: Destroys the surface.
description: Destroys this resource-owned browser surface, removes all of its Lua event handlers and invalidates the page handle. Resource teardown performs the same cleanup automatically.

name: hide
summary: Hides the surface.
description: Makes the owned browser surface invisible without destroying its document or handlers. Visibility is client-local and can be restored with `show()`.

name: id
summary: Numeric id of the surface.
description: Returns the opaque client-local surface id for diagnostics and host integration. It is not a network id and must not be persisted across page destruction or resource reload.

name: off
summary: Removes a handler registered with `on`.
description: Removes one WebUI callback id previously returned by `page:on`. The id must belong to this page and the current resource generation.

name: on
summary: Listens for an event the page raised with `CyberM.emit`.
description: Registers a Lua callback for an event emitted by this page's JavaScript bridge. Event names and handler counts are bounded, and the registration is automatically removed with the page or resource generation.

name: reply
summary: Answers an `invoke` call made by the page.
description: Completes a pending JavaScript request identified by its request id with a JSON-serializable Lua value. Request ids are page-local and invalid or unsupported payloads are rejected.

name: send
summary: Sends an event to the page.
description: Sends a named event and JSON-serializable payload from Lua to this page's JavaScript runtime. This is local UI IPC, not a network event, and both event names and payloads are bounded.

name: setFocus
summary: Gives the surface focus, cursor and keyboard separately.
description: Keyboard capture is asked for separately so a page can take the mouse without depriving the game of the movement keys.

name: show
summary: Shows the surface.
description: Avoid calling this right after `create` — see the race described in `CyberM.webui.create`.

name: all
summary: Lists authoritative server vehicles.
description: Returns snapshots ordered by CyberM ID. An optional routing bucket filters the result; omitting it returns every vehicle visible to the resource.

name: breakAllGlass
summary: Breaks a range of vehicle glass elements.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Breaks the first `count` destructible-glass bits. The optional count defaults to all 32 and must be in 0..32.

name: breakGlass
summary: Breaks one vehicle glass element.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setGlassBroken(id, glass, true)`; the canonical bit is replicated and retained for late joiners.

name: breakLight
summary: Breaks one vehicle light.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setLightBroken(id, index, true)`.

name: breakTire
summary: Breaks one vehicle tire.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setTireBroken(id, index, true)`. Tire indexes are 0..3.

name: closeDoor
summary: Closes a door, trunk, or hood.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setDoorOpen(id, door, false)`.

name: closeWindow
summary: Closes one side window.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setWindowOpen(id, window, false)`.

name: create
summary: Creates a server-owned network vehicle.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The definition selects the record, transform, routing bucket, appearance, colors, flags, health, and optional initial damage. The server allocates the CyberM ID and replicates the canonical vehicle to interested clients.

name: damageBodyCell
summary: Adds damage to one body cell.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Adds the amount to the current normalized cell and clamps the result to 0..1.

name: damageBodyZone
summary: Adds damage across a body zone.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Adds the amount to each selected body cell and clamps every result to 0..1.

name: get
summary: Returns one authoritative server vehicle snapshot.
description: Reads canonical identity, transform, flags, colors, damage, openings, occupants, and authority state. Returns `nil` for an unknown ID.

name: getDamage
summary: Returns the canonical damage snapshot.
description: Reads the server-owned body grid and broken glass, light, and tire masks. It returns `nil` when the vehicle ID is unknown.

name: getDamageProfile
summary: Returns a resource-local vehicle damage profile.
description: Reads the profile registered by the current server resource for the specified vehicle record. Profiles are not shared implicitly between resources.

name: isDoorOpen
summary: Reads one canonical door opening state.
description: Server-side authoritative query covering four doors, trunk, and hood. Returns `nil` for an unknown vehicle ID.

name: isWindowOpen
summary: Reads one canonical side-window opening state.
description: Server-side authoritative query for indexes 0..3. It does not report broken glass and returns `nil` for an unknown vehicle.

name: openDoor
summary: Opens a door, trunk, or hood.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setDoorOpen(id, door, true)`.

name: openWindow
summary: Opens one side window.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setWindowOpen(id, window, true)`.

name: registerDamageProfile
summary: Registers resource-local named damage zones and glass parts.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Profiles are scoped to the calling server resource VM and can extend or override the default body-zone mapping for one vehicle record.

name: remove
summary: Removes a server-owned network vehicle.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Only the resource that created the vehicle may remove it. Removal clears occupancy and authority before notifying streamed clients.

name: repair
summary: Repairs a selected vehicle damage scope.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Supported scopes are `glass`, `body`, `lights`, `tires`, `visual`, `mechanical`, and `full`. The default is `full`.

name: repairAllGlass
summary: Repairs all vehicle glass.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Clears the complete canonical broken-glass mask.

name: repairAllLights
summary: Repairs every vehicle light.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Clears the complete canonical broken-light mask.

name: repairAllTires
summary: Repairs all four vehicle tires.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Clears the complete canonical broken-tire mask.

name: repairBodyCell
summary: Repairs one body cell.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Sets the selected 1-based body cell to zero damage and replicates the repaired state.

name: repairBodyZone
summary: Repairs every body cell in a zone.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Clears all cells selected by a registered zone name or explicit index array.

name: repairGlass
summary: Repairs one vehicle glass element.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setGlassBroken(id, glass, false)`.

name: repairLight
summary: Repairs one vehicle light.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setLightBroken(id, index, false)`.

name: repairTire
summary: Repairs one vehicle tire.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Convenience wrapper over `setTireBroken(id, index, false)`.

name: setBodyCell
summary: Sets one body-damage cell.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Lua body-cell indexes are 1..30 and the value is clamped or validated in the normalized 0..1 range.

name: setBodyDamage
summary: Replaces the complete body-damage grid.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The table must contain exactly 30 normalized finite values in the range 0..1.

name: setBodyZone
summary: Sets all body cells in a zone.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The zone may be a registered zone name or an explicit array of cell indexes. Every selected cell receives the normalized value.

name: setDamage
summary: Replaces multiple canonical damage components at once.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Accepts a combined damage table and validates body cells and bit masks before publishing one authoritative update.

name: setDoorMask
summary: Replaces the vehicle opening mask.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The six-bit mask covers four doors, trunk, and hood. Valid values are 0..63.

name: setDoorOpen
summary: Sets one door, trunk, or hood opening state.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. `door` is an index 0..5 or one of the constants in `CyberM.vehicles.doors`.

name: setGlassBroken
summary: Sets or clears one broken-glass bit.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. `glass` may be a numeric 0..31 index or a name supplied by the resource's registered damage profile.

name: setGlassMask
summary: Replaces the broken-glass bit mask.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The 32-bit mask describes destructible glass records, not the four reversible side-window opening states.

name: setLightBroken
summary: Sets or clears one broken-light bit.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. The light index must be in 0..31.

name: setLightMask
summary: Replaces the broken-light bit mask.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Replaces the complete 32-bit canonical broken-light mask.

name: setTireBroken
summary: Sets or clears one broken tire.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Mutates one tire index in 0..3 and replicates the canonical state to streamed observers.

name: setTireMask
summary: Replaces the broken-tire bit mask.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Only the lower four bits are valid and correspond to tire indexes 0..3.

name: setTransform
summary: Moves a vehicle authoritatively.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Updates position and yaw, revokes any active physics lease, and publishes the new canonical transform to current viewers.

name: setWindowOpen
summary: Sets one reversible side-window opening state.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. This controls the four openable side windows and is separate from destructible broken-glass state.

name: update
summary: Updates canonical durable vehicle fields.
description: Requires `world.vehicles`. Applies only supplied fields, such as health, flags, colors, door/window/tire masks, body damage, broken glass, or broken lights. The authoritative result is persisted and replicated to current viewers and late joiners.
